measurement_boundary: Complete unchanged KH backend flow plus JSON encode/decode; excludes HTTP, session middleware, browser, network and production services.
cold_definition: Django caches cleared before every sample; interpreter, schema, OS and SQLite already initialized.
warm_definition: One untimed warmup per process; fresh calculation context for every request.
uncertainty: Ten samples per mode and variant across two fresh processes. Inclusive IQR and min/max describe observed dispersion, not a confidence interval. Balanced A-B-C-C-B-A order; no parallel tests.
sample_encoding: Arrays within each mode share sample order; hash sets include every sample. Full raw traces and receipts remain at /tmp/kh-gm583-list-optimization/final-performance.
